channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kel'el Ware | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kel'el Ware from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Pat Riley on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Riley on Ware and Spoelstra,

“As far as Kel'el and Bam, I like it. You've got to be committed to it.”

Pat Riley on Kel'el Ware, Apr 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyler Herro on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Heat guard Tyler Herro said.

“There are going to be ups and downs. He’s still learning. The best thing about Kel’el is he wants to learn, he wants to be great. And there’s going to be ups and downs. You see tonight his potential that he could tap into, seven blocks. It should have been eight. And he’s continuing to get better.”

Tyler Herro on Kel'el Ware, Mar 6, 2026. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Spoelstra:

“Kel’el gave us really solid minutes tonight. I was encouraged by his defensive activity.... It's good to have him get some extended minutes tonight.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Coach Spo on Kel'el Ware after playing just 3 minutes:

“Look I know every press conference ends up being about him and I really dont want it to be that. This is not a knock on Kel'el. This game was so fast. They were playing SFs at Center. The advantage was the speed”

Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware, Jan 31, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Two days after benching Miami Heat second-year center Kel’el Ware and then calling him out after Thursday’s home loss to the Boston Celtics, Heat coach Erik Spoelstra clarified his postgame comments.

“I didn’t articulate that in a great way and that wasn’t fair to Kel’el,”

Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware, Jan 18, 2026. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Spoelstra said when asked about Ware’s recent production.

“It’s not always just about the stats, but he’s come a long way. He’s improving. I want him to play with confidence. ... Kel’el is improving vastly.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kel'el Ware, Dec 23, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Bam Adebayo on mentoring Kel’el Ware:

“I’m hard on Kel’el. He probably looks at me like I’m crazy sometimes. Yelling in the gym. Being somebody that wants more from him because he has all the potential in the world.”

Bam Adebayo on Kel'el Ware, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic, Kel'el Ware
item.description:
“And then, you know, we have some really talented young guys that he understands that Kel'el [Ware] and Niko [Jovic],”

Erik Spoelstra on Nikola Jovic, Kel'el Ware, Jan 1, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Pat Riley on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Pat Riley on Kel’el Ware:

“His name kept popping up in front of me. Videos kept coming. His workout was exceptional.”

Pat Riley on Kel'el Ware, Jun 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Adam Simon on Kel'el Ware
item.description:
Heat assistant GM Adam Simon on Kel'el Ware:

“I think his skill set will be great to play with Bam and as well as when Bam is off the court.”

Adam Simon on Kel'el Ware, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.
